'''''Lonely Five''''' was the personal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] and [[Jedi archaeologist|archaeologist]] [[Rachi Sitra]]. It was a blue and white [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] named after the [[Lonely Five Range]] of mountains on her home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

Sitra piloted this ship in many air and space battles alongside the bravest star pilots in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who fought alongside her in their [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] starfighters.
